personas.label: The Firehose
personas.description: Every qualifying edge, one unit each, best price across all bettable books. Not a person: the statistical benchmark the others are measured against.

personas.label: The Disciplined Flat Bettor
personas.description: Five bets a day, one unit each, DraftKings only. Never two bets on one player. The most realistic recreational profile.

personas.label: The Line Shopper
personas.description: Same rules as the Disciplined Flat Bettor, but shops every bettable book for the best price. The gap between the two is what line shopping is worth.

personas.label: The Kelly Compounder
personas.description: Quarter-Kelly on a bankroll that compounds all season, up to 12 bets a day across all books. Stakes grow after good runs and shrink after bad ones.

personas.label: The Daily Budget
personas.description: Ten units a day, fully committed, spread across the top five edges in proportion to edge size. Bets the same amount every day however good the slate is.

personas.label: The Purist
personas.description: Only markets where both sides are quoted, so the price can be de-vigged and the edge measured against what the market believes. Ranked by that de-vigged disagreement.

personas.label: The Sharp Follower
personas.description: The Line Shopper, but a bet is only placed when the sharp books' own fair price does not contradict it. Tests whether the simulator beats the hardest part of the market, not just the soft books.

presets.label: Realistic
presets.description: What a careful bettor would place: odds -400..+200, lines at least three books quote, one bet per player/stat at the best rung and price, placed at the first capture where it qualifies.

presets.label: Sharp books
presets.description: Only FanDuel and DraftKings (plus Pinnacle and Circa as reference prices), and only bets the sharp books' own price does not contradict. The test of whether the simulator beats the hardest part of the market.

presets.label: Ladders
presets.description: Every qualifying rung. High volume and long odds; compare with Realistic.

presets.label: Everything
presets.description: No filtering beyond a 3% edge: every book, rung and capture counted. The number to be most suspicious of.
